answer_1.quote: Semantic-Eval was systematically evaluated on seven English datasets and one Dutch dataset, encompassing four tasks in NLP: sentiment analysis, text summarization, natural language Q&A, and sentence similarity.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated text outputs from LLMs across multiple NLP tasks, including summarization, sentiment analysis, question answering, and sentence similarity.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 consistently achieved the highest evaluation scores, most closely mirroring human judgments, while Semantic-Eval ranked second.

answer_4.guideline: The annotators scored the similarity of text pairs, and the dataset's evaluation scores were used to compute correlations with automatic metrics.
